svg.text: Stage 2 power board: parts side (top view)
24 x 18 hole pad-per-hole perfboard. Columns A-X, rows 1-18. Dots are the holes each part's legs go in.
F1, F2: 18 AWG wires on the parts side, clamped in the screw terminals. F2 drops through hole X15.
INA260 header: Vcc at O7 down to Vin- at O14. Screws face the right-hand board edge.
Q1-Q3: SOT-23 adapters standing upright. G/S/D = gate, source, drain. Check your adapter's order first.
Rounded resistors (R2, R4, R5, R7) stand upright in two neighbouring holes. R1, R3, R6 lie flat.
Arrows on J-BAT, J-LINK, J-COIL show which way the wire openings face.
